metadata.title: Greek Essence | Thoughtful journeys through Greece
metadata.description: Discover a more personal way to explore Greece, shaped around place, pace, and meaningful local moments.

hero.title: Greece, experienced with intention
hero.summary: Slow down, look closer, and discover an island journey shaped around the way you want to travel.

media.alt: A traveler with a suitcase is welcomed beside an Aegean coastline.

promise.heading: More than a list of places
body: Greek Essence brings together considered routes, a feeling for place, and room to travel at your own rhythm.
Every journey begins with what matters to you, not with a fixed package.

parosFeature.title: Paros & Antiparos
parosFeature.summary: Whitewashed villages, clear coves, generous tables, and two islands with distinct but complementary rhythms.

media.alt: People walk beside fishing boats and whitewashed houses on a Cycladic waterfront.

steps.summary: Tell us where your curiosity leads and how you like to travel.

steps.title: Shape the journey
steps.summary: Your interests become the starting point for a thoughtful route.

steps.title: Travel with clarity
steps.summary: Review a coherent plan designed around your pace and priorities.

trustStory.heading: A closer relationship with Greece
body: We believe the most memorable journeys leave space for character: a quiet harbour, an unhurried meal, a conversation that changes the day.
Our role is to connect those moments into a journey that feels considered and genuinely yours.

metadata.title: Paros & Antiparos | Greek Essence
metadata.description: Discover the character, rhythm, and thoughtful possibilities of Paros and Antiparos.

hero.title: Paros & Antiparos, in your own rhythm
hero.summary: Two close islands bring together village life, open water, generous tables, and room to choose the pace.

media.alt: People walk beside fishing boats and whitewashed houses on a Cycladic waterfront.

introduction.heading: Easy-going days with a sense of place
body: Paros brings whitewashed lanes, working harbours, and a sociable island energy without asking every day to look the same.
Across the water, Antiparos offers a quieter counterpoint of simple coves, unhurried walks, and intimate scale.

items.title: Travelers who like to linger
items.summary: For people who would rather return to a favourite table or beach than collect a long list of stops.

items.title: Couples, friends, and families
items.summary: A flexible setting with enough variety to make space for different interests.

signatureExperiences.heading: Signature ways to spend the day

items.title: Culture and gastronomy
items.summary: Follow the day from village streets and local craft to a generous meal shaped by the season.

media.alt: Hands knead bread beside fresh herbs in a whitewashed kitchen.

items.title: Sea time and local life
items.summary: Balance time on the water with small harbours, shaded pauses, and a slower island evening.

media.alt: Two people share a basket of vegetables in a shaded Cycladic courtyard.

items.title: One paired island stay
items.summary: Use Paros and Antiparos together for contrast without constant movement.

items.title: A considered Cycladic continuation
items.summary: The pairing can become one chapter in a wider Greek journey shaped around your time.
